note: Side suffixes: MakeHuman .L/.R and humanoid/v1 _l/_r both mean the character's own left/right (+X in Blender, +X in glTF).
collapse_rule: When driving only the 26 mapped joints, fold each unmapped deform bone's weights into its nearest mapped ancestor (e.g. upperarm02.* -> upperarm01.*, spine04 -> spine05, spine02 -> spine01, neck02/neck03 -> neck01, fingers/metacarpals -> wrist, toes -> foot, face bones -> head except jaw/eyes).
